changes_made.explanation: Normalized model and dataset names to standard forms. Removed duplicate dataset entries and consolidated task descriptions. Added missing task (toxicity avoidance) and output type (entity-guided summaries) mentioned in the paper.
Consolidated metric variants under base forms (e.g., Distinct-1/2/3 → Distinct-n). Removed redundant descriptions and kept only the normalized metric names.
Removed incorrect items. GPT-2 XL was used for perplexity calculation as part of automatic evaluation, not as an LLM judge assessing outputs after generation. The paper does not use LLMs as judges.

overall_notes: The paper presents MuCoLa, a gradient-based constrained sampling method for language models. It evaluates on multiple NLG tasks using both automatic metrics and human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy and inconsistent naming. The paper does not use LLMs as judges - GPT-2 XL was used for perplexity calculation as part of automatic evaluation, not as a post-hoc evaluator.
